verifications.claim: The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival in Washington, D.C. runs from March 20 to April 13.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "The National Cherry Blossom Festival (March 20 – April 12, 2026)" (R6); "National Cherry Blossom Festival (March 20 to April 12)" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state festival runs March 20 to April 12, directly contradicting claim's April 13 end date.

verifications.claim: Peak bloom typically occurs in late March or early April.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Cherry blossom season typically peaks between late March and early April" (R2); "peak bloom occurs between the last week of March and the first week of April" (R7, R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm typical timing as late March to early April.
